lines: The farm's rehearsal chunk drew the first 4K frames of film B (about 80 s a frame) and found a fault before the masters start: frames 4, 6 and 8 each hold 3 values that are not finite before the lens and the grade (open item 237).
No blotch shows in those three pictures, and the masters' tool refuses their chunk all the same. A farm machine hunts the cause from 13:10; no master frame is drawn until a scan of the film is clean.
Summer's third fix list is with five builders until about 13:37. Round 21 is called only when my own look at the merged picture finds nothing I can name.
The frost and the crack on the glass are mended on the change's branch (they thin evenly where they left as dots at one sample); merge and checks are next.
The motion sheets of the present main are in: the shake from spring to summer and the summer shot, both before the third list.
phase 6: 10.51 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 10.51 h used of 12.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Film B frame 5 as the farm drew it at 3840 x 2160 with 24 samples, shown at 1600 px wide: winter in the first shot's close view.
The same frame at full size, a window of 1400 x 788 px: the lights along the eave, a lit bough, falling snow.
Twelve frames across the shake from spring to summer at review quality: petals rise, the glass fills, the outside changes in the dark frame 1400, summer shows through from 1426.
Twelve frames of the summer shot, 1440 to 2014: the storm thins, the camera goes in and comes back. This is summer before the third list.
